quickAnswer.question: How much does an international trip cost from Trivandrum?
quickAnswer.answer: International trip costs from Trivandrum vary by destination and tier: Sri Lanka from ₹20,000/person (4N/5D budget), Vietnam from ₹45,000, Bali from ₹35,000, Thailand from ₹40,000, Singapore-Malaysia from ₹45,000, and Dubai from ₹40,000. Use the calculator below to estimate your total cost based on group size, travel tier, and trip duration.

intro: This calculator provides indicative cost estimates based on iWay Tourism's current package baselines. The figures reflect per-person pricing on a twin-sharing basis and include flights from Trivandrum (TRV), visa processing, hotel accommodation, airport transfers, and sightseeing as listed in the corresponding package page. Actual quotes may vary based on travel dates, flight availability, hotel selection, and seasonal pricing. For a binding quote, contact our team with your specific requirements.

tiers.name: Standard Heritage & Wildlife
tiers.highlights: Colombo, Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Ella train, Yala safari

estimatedDailySpend.note: Per person per day for meals, local transport, entry fees, and incidentals not included in the package.

tiers.name: Budget Explorer
tiers.highlights: Hanoi, Ha Long Bay day cruise, Ninh Binh

tiers.name: Standard Adventure
tiers.highlights: Hanoi, Ha Long Bay overnight, Sapa or Da Nang/Hoi An

estimatedDailySpend.note: Vietnam is exceptionally affordable. Street food meals cost ₹80–150; quality restaurant dinners ₹500–800.

tiers.name: Adventure Luxury
tiers.highlights: Private pool villa, Nusa Penida, Mount Batur trek, Uluwatu

estimatedDailySpend.note: Ubud is more affordable than Seminyak/Nusa Dua. Spa treatments range ₹500–₹3,000.

tiers.name: Bangkok + Pattaya Express
tiers.highlights: Grand Palace, Wat Pho, Coral Island, Pattaya

tiers.name: Bangkok + Phuket/Krabi Leisure
tiers.highlights: Bangkok, Phi Phi Islands or Four Islands, cooking class

estimatedDailySpend.note: Bangkok street food is legendary and cheap (₹100–250/meal). Phuket resort areas cost more.

tiers.name: Budget Express
tiers.highlights: Marina Bay, Sentosa, Batu Caves, KL city

tiers.name: Standard Leisure
tiers.highlights: Full Singapore, Sentosa, Night Safari, KL, Genting Highlands

tiers.name: Premium Cruise
tiers.highlights: Full Singapore, Universal Studios, KL, Genting, Genting Dream Cruise

estimatedDailySpend.note: Singapore is noticeably more expensive than Malaysia. Hawker centres (₹250–500/meal) are the best value in Singapore.

tiers.name: City Explorer
tiers.highlights: Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall, Old Dubai, desert safari

tiers.name: Premium Experience
tiers.highlights: Full city tour, premium desert safari, Marina cruise, Abu Dhabi

estimatedDailySpend.note: Dubai ranges from affordable (food courts ₹400–600) to ultra-premium. Gold Souk offers competitive gold pricing by weight.
